name: Schlangen (Germany)
description: Five horizontal stripes of blue, white, blue, white and blue with a broad middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Schlangen (an S-shaped serpent with a rose on white).
history: The arms show in silver (white) an S-shaped serpent; by deed of the Regierungspräsident in Detmold of 16 July 1970 the municipality of Schlangen was granted the right to bear them.

features.role: Schlangen arms — serpent with rose on white
